algorithm: ashr2.2-63 mixSQP with control eps=1e-4; all other parameters identical to registered adapter
meaning: epsilon is added to row mixture likelihoods in numerical objective/derivatives after per-row maximum likelihood normalization. Positive numerical likelihood floor regularizes unstable optimization; it is not a mixture prior or target/gene omission. Thus the numerical optimization objective is slightly perturbed, while family/grid/prior are unchanged. Reported ash loglik uses unregularized mixture likelihood.
classification: posthoc uniformly regularized numerical sensitivity, not exact unchanged-estimator confirmation
fallback: Any failed/nonconvergent fit yields incompletecohort; no omitted targets or fallbackweights
selection_criterion: numerical convergence on failed example and output comparison on original successfulfits; no ranking inspected
